command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; import {createHash} from "node:crypto"; const dir="docs/remediation/evidence/W02.02/"; const manifest=JSON.parse(readFileSync(dir+"artifact-manifest-v1.json")); const sha=x=>createHash("sha256").update(x).digest("hex"); const paths=new Set(manifest.files.map(f=>f.path)); for(const f of manifest.files)assert.equal(sha(readFileSync(f.path)),f.sha256,f.path); const graphs=file=>readFileSync(dir+file,"utf8").split("\n").flatMap(line=>{try{const row=JSON.parse(line);return Array.isArray(row.inputs)?[row]:[];}catch{return[];}}); const retained=graphs("k2-final-v1.log"), repeated=graphs("reviewer-k2-v1.log"), independent=graphs("reviewer-challenge-v1.log"); assert.equal(retained.length,2);assert.equal(repeated.length,2);assert.equal(independent.length,2); const normalize=row=>row.inputs.filter(path=>path!=="<stdin>"&&path!=="reviewer-runtime.ts").sort(); for(let i=0;i<2;i++){assert.deepEqual(normalize(repeated[i]),normalize(retained[i]));assert.deepEqual(normalize(independent[i]),normalize(retained[i]));for(const path of normalize(independent[i]))assert.ok(paths.has(path),path);}console.log(JSON.stringify({at:new Date().toISOString(),verdict:"pass",artifact_digest:manifest.digest,rehashFiles:manifest.files.length,graphs:independent.map((r,i)=>({basis:r.basis,actualInputs:r.inputs.length,pinnedFileInputs:normalize(r).length,matchWorkerAndRepeated:true})),readWorkerSha256:sha(readFileSync(dir+"worker.md")),leadChecksSha256:sha(readFileSync(dir+"lead-checks-v1.json"))}));'
